text: The absence of accountability mechanisms in anonymous, automated smart contracts encourages a take the money and run mentality, which makes a historical record of conduct and incentives for ethical behavior necessary.
citation: Furrer Andreas, Wulf A. Kaal, Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC) Building the Legal Infrastructure for the Digital Era (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5554218

isBasedOn.name: Universal Digital Law Codex (UDLC) Building the Legal Infrastructure for the Digital Era

abstract: We argue that the absence of accountability mechanisms in anonymous, automated smart contracts encourages a "take the money and run" mentality, necessitating a historical record of conduct and incentives for ethical behavior.
